[Section] Framework Description ::: Our Proposed Model ::: Overview.
[source_id=20] As shown in Figure FIGREF10, our framework consists offour components (1) Sentence Encoder and Relation Encoder, (2) Decoder, (3) Gated Attention Mechanism and (4) Dual Copy Mechanism. The sentence encoder and relation encoder encode the unstructured sentence and the structured answer-relevant relation, respectively. To select and combine the source information from the two encoders, a gated attention mechanism is employed to jointly attend both contextualized information sources, and a dual copy mechanism copies words from either the sentence or the relation.
